scripts.start: npm run build && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist/main.js
scripts.test: npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.migration:generate: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev typeorm migration:generate src/modules/database/migrations/InitialSchema -d dist/modules/database/data-source.js
scripts.migrate: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev typeorm migration:run -d dist/modules/database/data-source.js
scripts.migrate:show: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev typeorm migration:show -d dist/modules/database/data-source.js
scripts.migrate:revert: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev typeorm migration:revert -d dist/modules/database/data-source.js
scripts.seed: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist/modules/database/seed/main.js
scripts.demo:nplus1: npm run build:demo --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist-demo/demo/demo-nplus1.js
scripts.demo:race: npm run build:demo --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist-demo/demo/demo-race.js
scripts.demo:workers: npm run build:demo --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist-demo/demo/demo-workers.js
scripts.demo:retry: npm run build:demo --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist-demo/demo/demo-retry.js
scripts.report: npm run build:demo --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist-demo/demo/report.js
